new_primary.title: CP-Algorithms — Knuth's Optimization
new_primary.instruction: Treat this as an introduction to what advanced DP means: exploiting additional mathematical structure in a transition to reduce complexity. Understand range DP, optimal split points, the monotonicity condition, and why the optimization can reduce O(n^3) range DP to O(n^2).
